_comment: Packaging options passed to x9/tools/boot-xnu.py, taken from pan220 build.sh. root_manifest comes from local.json (device data, never committed).
_comment_defaults: X9 kernel feature switches proven on the device are default-on in the kernel (sweet_x9_arg, osfmk/arm64/sweet_early.c; LK banner blank in pe_serial.c); pass name=0 to turn one off. x9_metal_render=1 stays because the X9GeneralMetal plugin reads it from kern.bootargs.
